Discovered Using Patient-derived Xenograft Model Experiment 1 Reporting the Activity Date of This ADC [ 12 ] Efficacy Data Tumor Growth Inhibition value (TGI) ≈ 96.10% (Day 21) High MET expression ( MET+++ ; IHC H-score=265) Method Description Female Athymic Nude-Foxn1nu from Envigo (head and neck,triple-negative breast cancer models),68 weeks of age,were used for the PDX studies. Low passage tumor fragments were implanted into stock animals. When tumors reached 1.01.5 cm3,they were reimplanted into prestudy animals unilaterally on the left flank. When tumors reached an average tumor volume of 150-300 mm 3 ,animals were matched by tumor volume into treatment or vehicle control groups. Three animals were assigned to each group and dosed intravenously by tail vein injection (10 mL/kg). Tumor volumes were measured twice weekly by calipers. Prostate cancer subcutaneous PDX model treated with MGC018 or control ADC at 3 mg/kg (QW3).
